svg.text: Exon and domain architecture per species · native amino-acid coordinates
For each species, where do the coding exon boundaries of the primary protein fall relative to the edges of its annotated domains?
Amino-acid position on each species' own primary protein
Both tracks of a species share that species' own amino-acid axis. Native axes are not comparable position by position between species; the MSA-aligned panel places every species on one axis.
